_comment: Copy to ~/.config/gamepad-remapd/daemon.json (Windows: %APPDATA%\gamepad-remapd\daemon.json). All keys are optional.

overrides._comment: example: force-bind a VID:PID to the layout from devices/my_2g4_receiver.json

keyboard._comment: Keyboard as a gamepad (Linux). Off while enabled=false. Find your keyboard: gamepad-remapd keyboards. While the mode is active, the keyboard is grabbed from the system (grab); the toggle gives it back instantly.
